notices.text_zh: 公共部门劳资行动还在继续。国立博物馆 11 月 1 日关闭了基尔代尔街馆，死动物园实验室 11 月 7 日、8 日的抽签导览也已取消。馆方说之后还可能临时闭馆或取消活动，去博物馆前先打开来源页确认。
notices.text_en: Public-sector industrial action is still going on. The National Museum closed its Kildare Street site on 1 November, and the Dead Zoo Lab lottery tours on 7 and 8 November are cancelled. The museum says more closures or cancellations can happen at short notice. Check the source page before you go to any museum event.

events.title_zh: LexIcon：希腊航海传统展
events.description_zh: 「希腊航海传统一万年」在 LexIcon 从 10 月 15 日展到 11 月 29 日。10 月 24 日至 26 日全馆闭馆，所以这几天去不了；27 日重新开放后可以看。周六 9:30–17:00 有工作人员，周日 12:00–16:00 只有自助。不是有主持的儿童场。
events.address: Haigh Terrace, Dún Laoghaire, A96 H283
events.schedule_note_zh: 10 月 27 日起可看，展至 11 月 29 日；周六有馆员，周日仅自助

price.note_zh: 图书馆展览，活动页没有另标票价
price.note_en: A library exhibition. The event page does not list a separate ticket price

events.description_en: “10,000 Years of Hellenic Maritime Tradition” is at LexIcon from 15 October to 29 November. The building is closed 24–26 October, so you cannot see it then. It is back from the 27th. Saturday 9:30–17:00 is staffed. Sunday 12:00–16:00 is self-service only. It is not a hosted children’s session.
events.schedule_note_en: On view from 27 October, until 29 November; staffed on Saturday, self-service only on Sunday
events.age_hint_en: School-age children will get more from it

events.title_zh: 都柏林动物园：恐龙发现体验
events.description_zh: 动物园秋冬日历写明 11 月 7 日有「恐龙发现」家庭体验，对象是 3–8 岁孩子和陪同大人。日历把它和限量工作坊放在一起，需要预约。没有写钟点，也没有写是否还要另买日票。
events.address: Phoenix Park, Dublin 8, D08 AC98

price.note_zh: 体验另售，钟点和是否包含日票以预订页为准
price.note_en: Sold separately. Times, and whether a day ticket is included, are on the booking page

events.description_en: The zoo’s autumn–winter calendar lists a “Dinosaur Discovery” family session on 7 November, for children aged 3–8 and the adult with them. It is grouped with the limited workshops and needs a booking. It does not give a time, and it does not say whether you also need a day ticket.
events.schedule_note_en: The calendar does not give a start time

events.title_zh: 都柏林动物园：小鸟亲子团
events.description_zh: 日历上的 Zoo Tots「羽毛朋友」，对象大约 1–4 岁和大人。11 月 4 日和 11 月 7 日都有，本条是周六这场。低龄专场，需要预约。日历没有写钟点，也没有写清是否包含入园门票。
events.address: Phoenix Park, Dublin 8, D08 AC98
events.schedule_note_zh: 11 月 4 日另有一场；周六这场没有写钟点

price.note_zh: 低龄专场，票价和钟点以动物园预订页为准
price.note_en: A session for little ones. Price and time are on the zoo booking page

events.description_en: Zoo Tots “Feathered Friends” on the calendar, for about ages 1–4 and an adult. It runs on 4 November and 7 November. This listing is the Saturday one. It is a young-children session and needs a booking. The calendar does not give a time, and it is not clear whether zoo entry is included.
events.schedule_note_en: Another session on 4 November; this Saturday one has no published time

events.title_zh: 爱尔兰现代艺术博物馆：周日免费
events.description_zh: 基尔迈纳姆的现代艺术博物馆，门票免费，建筑和院子本身可以带孩子走走。周日 12:00–17:30，展览最晚 17:15 入场。周一平常关闭，银行假日按周日时间。11 月 8 日只是周日开放，页面没有单列家庭工作坊。
events.venue: 爱尔兰现代艺术博物馆（IMMA）
events.address: Royal Hospital Kilmainham, Military Road, Dublin 8, D08 FW31

price.note_zh: 门票免费
price.note_en: Free admission

events.description_en: The Irish Museum of Modern Art at Kilmainham. Admission is free, and the building and courtyard are worth a walk with children. Sunday 12:00–17:30, last exhibition entry 17:15. Usually closed on Monday; bank holidays follow Sunday hours. 8 November is just a Sunday opening. The page does not list a separate family workshop.
events.schedule_note_en: Sunday 12:00–17:30, last exhibition entry 17:15

events.title_zh: 总统府：周六免费导览（11 月）
events.description_zh: 同一套免费室内导览的 11 月 7 日场：10:00、11:15、12:30、13:45、15:00，大约 75 分钟。票仍在凤凰公园游客中心当天领，不能提前订。花园导览页面只写到 10 月，这场按室内导览准备。要带带照片的证件。游客中心有游乐场和咖啡馆，导览太长的小孩可以留在那里。11 月 21 日没有导览，与这场无关。国事忙时会取消。
events.venue: 凤凰公园游客中心（领票）／总统府
events.address: Phoenix Park Visitor Centre, Phoenix Park, Dublin 8

price.note_zh: 导览免费。票在游客中心当天领
price.note_en: The tour is free. Collect tickets at the Visitor Centre on the day

events.age_hint: 更适合能安静走一小时的孩子
events.booking_zh: 当天先到先得，须带照片证件
events.title_en: Áras an Uachtaráin: free Saturday tour (November)
events.description_en: The same free indoor tour on 7 November: 10:00, 11:15, 12:30, 13:45 and 15:00, about 75 minutes. Tickets are still collected that day at the Phoenix Park Visitor Centre. You cannot book ahead. The garden-tour page only runs through October, so plan on the indoor tour. Bring photo ID. The Visitor Centre has a playground and a café if the tour is too long for a child. There is no tour on 21 November; that does not affect this one. Tours are cancelled when state business takes over.
events.venue_en: Phoenix Park Visitor Centre (tickets) / Áras an Uachtaráin
events.age_hint_en: Better for children who can walk quietly for an hour
events.booking_en: Same-day, first come; bring photo ID

events.title_zh: 法姆利庄园：园地免费开放
events.description_zh: 凤凰公园西北角的法姆利，园地、花园和画廊免费，每天 10:00–18:00，最晚 17:00 入场。房子为欧盟轮值主席国闭到 2026 年底，不要按室内导览去。户外免费导览 11:30 和 14:30，看天气，票在 Motorhouse 接待处的导游台领。园里有牛羊，狗必须牵绳。船屋咖啡馆每天开。这条先记到 11 月 8 日，之后是否照常以遗产局页面为准。
events.venue: 法姆利庄园（Farmleigh House and Estate）
events.address: Phoenix Park, Dublin 15, D15 TD50

price.note_zh: 园地、花园和画廊免费。房子今年不开放，室内导览票价用不上
price.note_en: Grounds, gardens and gallery are free. The house is closed this year, so indoor tour prices do not apply

events.booking_zh: 进园不用预约；户外导览在导游台领票
events.description_en: Farmleigh, in the north-west corner of Phoenix Park. Grounds, gardens and gallery are free, daily 10:00–18:00, last entry 17:00. The house is closed until the end of 2026 for the EU presidency, so do not come for an indoor tour. Free outdoor tours at 11:30 and 14:30, weather permitting. Collect tickets at the guide desk in the Motorhouse reception. There are cattle and sheep. Dogs must be on a lead. The Boathouse Café is open daily. This listing runs to 8 November. After that, check the Heritage Ireland page.
events.schedule_note_en: Daily 10:00–18:00, last entry 17:00; outdoor tours at 11:30 and 14:30
events.booking_en: No booking for the grounds; outdoor tours collect tickets at the guide desk

events.title_zh: 马什图书馆：周六自助参观（11 月）
events.description_zh: 同一座旧图书馆的 11 月 7 日周六场，10:00–17:00。小孩可以参加小人仔寻宝。展厅没有轮椅通道。票价和 10 月 31 日一样：成人 €8，学生和老人 €6，18 岁以下个人免费。
events.address: St Patrick's Close, Dublin, D08 FK79

price.note_zh: 成人 €8，学生或老人 €6，18 岁以下个人免费。18 岁以下团体每人 €3
price.note_en: Adult €8, student or senior €6, under 18 free as an individual. Under-18 groups are €3 each

events.age_hint: 学龄儿童更合适，请小声
events.booking_zh: 可当天买票，也可网上订
events.description_en: The same old library on Saturday 7 November, 10:00–17:00. Children can do the miniature treasure hunt. The galleries have no wheelchair access. Prices match 31 October: adult €8, student and senior €6, under 18 free as an individual.
events.schedule_note_en: Saturday 10:00–17:00
events.age_hint_en: School-age children; please keep voices down
events.booking_en: Buy on the day, or book online

events.title_zh: 国立美术馆：风笛与画
events.description_zh: 11 月 7 日 11:30–12:30，都柏林风笛手 Mick O'Brien 先讲爱尔兰风笛，再和导览一起看馆里和音乐有关的画。国际风笛日活动，免费，不用预约。在梅里恩广场入口附近的庭院集合。常设展免费。
events.venue: 爱尔兰国立美术馆（National Gallery of Ireland）
events.address: Merrion Square West, Dublin 2

price.note_zh: 导览免费。常设展免费，部分临时展览另收费
price.note_en: The tour is free. The permanent collection is free. Some temporary exhibitions charge

events.description_en: On 7 November, 11:30–12:30, Dublin uilleann piper Mick O’Brien talks about the Irish pipes, then joins a tour of paintings in the gallery that have to do with music. An International Uilleann Piping Day event. Free, no booking. Meet in the courtyard near the Merrion Square entrance. The permanent collection is free.
events.age_hint_en: Whole family, if they can stand and listen for a bit

events.title_zh: 国立美术馆：周末免费开放
events.description_zh: 常设展免费。11 月 7 日周六 9:15–17:30，11 月 8 日周日 11:00–17:30，展厅大约 16:50 开始往下关。11 月 5 日到 8 日是都柏林画廊周末，What's on 上另有免费导览，包括周六 11:30 的风笛场。开放时间页提醒劳资行动可能临时闭馆。
events.venue: 爱尔兰国立美术馆（National Gallery of Ireland）
events.address: Merrion Square West, Dublin 2

price.note_zh: 常设展免费。部分临时展览另收费
price.note_en: The permanent collection is free. Some temporary exhibitions charge

events.description_en: The permanent collection is free. Saturday 7 November, 9:15–17:30. Sunday 8 November, 11:00–17:30. Galleries start closing from the top at about 16:50. 5–8 November is Dublin Gallery Weekend. What’s On also lists free tours, including the pipes session at 11:30 on Saturday. The opening-hours page warns that industrial action may close the building at short notice.

events.title_zh: 再发现中心：科学节
events.description_zh: Visit Dublin 列出的科学节，11 月 7 日 11:00–16:00，在巴利蒙再发现中心，主题含水和科学。免费，小孩必须有大人陪，页面说建议预约，但没有给订票链接。中心自己的开放时间是周一到周六 9:00–17:00，周日关，和这场周六对得上。时间以 Visit Dublin 为准，出发前可打 01 893 3801 确认。馆方写有多路 TFI 公交，开车从 M50 4 号出口大约 5–10 分钟，馆内免费车位有限。
events.address: The Boiler House, Ballymun Road, Ballymun, Dublin 9, D09 HK58

price.note_zh: Visit Dublin 标为免费。建议预约，页面没有订票链接
price.note_en: Visit Dublin marks it free. Booking is advised, and the page has no ticket link

events.description_en: A science festival listed by Visit Dublin, 7 November, 11:00–16:00, at the Rediscovery Centre in Ballymun, on water and science. Free. Children must come with an adult. The page says booking is advised but gives no ticket link. The centre’s own hours are Monday–Saturday 9:00–17:00, closed Sunday, which matches this Saturday. Times follow Visit Dublin. Call 01 893 3801 before you go if you want to confirm. The centre says several TFI buses stop nearby. By car it is about 5–10 minutes from M50 junction 4, and free parking on site is limited.

events.title_zh: 多纳贝特图书馆：故事舞蹈音乐
events.description_zh: 芬戈尔图书馆 2026 秋冬手册里的周六场，11 月 7 日 11:30，名字是 Scéalta, Rince agus Ceol，爱尔兰语故事、舞蹈和音乐。手册没有写结束时间和年龄。手册总述这些图书馆节目免费。
events.address: Ballisk House, Portrane Road, Donabate, Co. Dublin, K36 E009

price.note_zh: 手册把图书馆节目写成免费。没有另写预约方式
price.note_en: The brochure describes library events as free. It does not say how to book

events.booking_zh: 手册没有写要不要预约，可先打电话问馆
events.title_en: Donabate Library: stories, dance and music
events.description_en: A Saturday session in the Fingal Libraries autumn–winter 2026 brochure: 7 November, 11:30, called Scéalta, Rince agus Ceol — stories, dance and music in Irish. The brochure does not give an end time or an age. Its general note says these library events are free.
events.age_hint_en: The brochure doesn’t give an age
events.booking_en: The brochure doesn’t say if you need to book; call the library

events.title_zh: 多纳贝特图书馆：活动乐高
events.description_zh: 同一本 2026 秋冬手册，11 月 7 日 14:00 在多纳贝特图书馆的 Active Lego。手册没有写结束时间、年龄和预约方式。上午 11:30 还有一场爱尔兰语故事舞蹈。
events.address: Ballisk House, Portrane Road, Donabate, Co. Dublin, K36 E009

price.note_zh: 手册把图书馆节目写成免费
price.note_en: The brochure describes library events as free

events.booking_zh: 手册没有写要不要预约
events.description_en: From the same autumn–winter 2026 brochure: Active Lego at Donabate Library on 7 November at 14:00. The brochure does not give an end time, an age, or whether you need to book. There is also an Irish-language stories, dance and music session that morning at 11:30.
events.age_hint_en: The brochure doesn’t give an age
events.booking_en: The brochure doesn’t say if you need to book

events.title_zh: 都柏林动物园：11 月白天
events.description_zh: 万圣节寻宝小径排到 11 月 1 日。11 月 7 日周六和 8 日周日仍是白天开园。万圣节页写 11 月改成 9:30–16:00，最晚 15:00 入园。开放时间页会按季节改，出发前再对一下当天钟点。11 月 7 日另有要预约的恐龙体验和低龄小鸟团。
events.address: Phoenix Park, Dublin 8, D08 AC98

price.note_zh: 日票以购票页当天价为准。万圣节页写过线上成人 €22.50、儿童（3–15 岁）€17，3 岁以下免费，11 月是否同价以购票页为准
price.note_en: Day tickets are the price on the ticket page that day. The Halloween page listed online adult €22.50 and child (3–15) €17, under 3 free. Whether November matches that is on the ticket page

events.description_en: The Halloween treasure trail runs through 1 November. Saturday 7 November and Sunday 8 November are still ordinary daytime opening. The Halloween page says November hours change to 9:30–16:00, last entry 15:00. The opening-hours page changes with the season, so check that day’s times before you go. On 7 November there are also the bookable dinosaur session and the little-bird session for young children.
events.schedule_note_en: The Halloween page: November hours 9:30–16:00, last entry 15:00
events.booking_en: Buy a day ticket online if you can

events.title_zh: 艾尔菲尔德庄园：11 月周末
events.description_zh: 邓德拉姆的农场庄园，周二到周日 9:30–17:30，最后入场 16:30。本条是 11 月 7 日周六和 8 日周日。周一不开。成人票最高约 €15，2 岁及以下免费，儿童票以官网为准。
events.address: Overend Way, Dundrum, Dublin 14, D14 EE77

price.note_zh: 成人最高约 €15；2 岁及以下免费；儿童票以官网为准
price.note_en: Adults up to about €15; age 2 and under free; child prices are on the website

events.description_en: The farm estate in Dundrum, Tuesday–Sunday 9:30–17:30, last entry 16:30. This listing is Saturday 7 November and Sunday 8 November. Closed Monday. Adult tickets are up to about €15. Age 2 and under is free. Child prices are on the website.
events.schedule_note_en: Saturday and Sunday 9:30–17:30, last entry 16:30

events.title_zh: 考古馆：11 月第一个周末
events.description_zh: 基尔代尔街考古馆免费。11 月 7 日周六 10:00–17:00，11 月 8 日周日 13:00–17:00，建议 16:30 前入场。金饰和沼泽古物适合跟小学孩子讲。展厅偶尔会临时关，要看某一件可以先打 01 677 7444。
events.venue: 国立考古馆（National Museum of Ireland – Archaeology）
events.address: Kildare Street, Dublin 2, D02 FH48

price.note_zh: 门票免费
price.note_en: Free admission

events.title_en: Archaeology museum: the first November weekend
events.description_en: The archaeology museum on Kildare Street is free. Saturday 7 November, 10:00–17:00. Sunday 8 November, 13:00–17:00. Aim to be in by 16:30. Gold and bog bodies are a good fit for primary-school children. Galleries sometimes close at short notice. If you want a particular object, call 01 677 7444 first.
events.age_hint_en: School-age children will get more from it

events.title_zh: 都柏林尼亚：11 月周末参观
events.description_zh: 维京和中世纪馆。咒语瓶和魔杖工坊只排到 10 月 30 日。馆本身 10 月到 3 月每天 10:00–17:00，最晚 16:00 入场。本条是 11 月 7 日和 8 日，没有那场随到随做的手工。
events.address: St Michael's Hill, Christchurch, Dublin 8

price.note_en: Online: adult €16, child €11.50, student or senior €14.50. At the door: adult €18, child €11.50. Family tickets: 2 adults and 2 children €50.50, 1 adult and 2 children €34.85

events.description_en: The Viking and medieval museum. The spell-jar and wand workshop only runs through 30 October. The museum itself is open daily 10:00–17:00 from October to March, last entry 16:00. This listing is 7 and 8 November, without that drop-in craft.
events.schedule_note_en: Daily 10:00–17:00, last entry 16:00
events.age_hint_en: Whole family; the galleries have a lot of stairs
events.booking_en: Buy the ticket online if you can

events.title_zh: IMMA：周日家庭美术
events.description_zh: Explorer 家庭工坊，馆方写成 2026 年每周日 14:00，免费随到随做，名额有限。本条是 11 月 8 日。先看展，再一起做，材料馆方提供。到主楼问讯处问 Matheson Creativity Hub 怎么走。11 月 1 日另有万圣节专场，时间写到 16:00；这场结束时间页面没有单列。
events.venue: 爱尔兰现代艺术博物馆（IMMA）
events.address: Royal Hospital Kilmainham, Military Road, Dublin 8, D08 FW31

price.note_zh: 免费随到随做，名额有限
price.note_en: Free drop-in, places limited

events.description_en: The Explorer family workshop. The museum lists it at 14:00 every Sunday in 2026, free drop-in, places limited. This listing is 8 November. Look at the exhibition first, then make something together. Materials are provided. Ask at the main-building desk how to reach the Matheson Creativity Hub. 1 November has a separate Halloween session timed through 16:00. This one does not list its own end time.
events.schedule_note_en: From 14:00 on Sunday, drop-in

events.title_zh: 国立美术馆：周日家庭导览（11 月 8 日）
events.description_zh: 每周日 13:00–14:00 的家庭导览，本条是 11 月 8 日。在梅里恩广场入口附近的庭院集合，不用预约。常设展免费。同一周末上午还有风笛场，见另一条。开放时间页提醒劳资行动可能临时闭馆。
events.venue: 爱尔兰国立美术馆（National Gallery of Ireland）
events.address: Merrion Square West, Dublin 2

price.note_zh: 导览和常设展免费。部分临时展览另收费
price.note_en: The tour and the permanent collection are free. Some temporary exhibitions charge

events.title_en: National Gallery: Sunday family tour (8 November)
events.description_en: The Sunday family tour, 13:00–14:00 each week. This listing is 8 November. Meet in the courtyard near the Merrion Square entrance. No booking. The permanent collection is free. The same weekend also has the pipes session in the morning. See the other listing. The opening-hours page warns that industrial action may close the building at short notice.
events.age_hint_en: Children and the adult with them

events.title_zh: 巴尔多伊尔图书馆：感官游戏
events.description_zh: 芬戈尔图书馆 2026 秋冬手册，11 月 14 日周六 10:00 的 Sensory Play Hour。手册没有写结束时间和年龄，这类时段通常给低龄。手册总述图书馆节目免费。
events.venue: 巴尔多伊尔图书馆（Baldoyle Library）
events.address: The Mall, Baldoyle, Dublin 13, D13 Y304

price.note_zh: 手册把图书馆节目写成免费
price.note_en: The brochure describes library events as free

events.age_hint: 手册没有写年龄，低龄更合适
events.booking_zh: 手册没有写要不要预约
events.description_en: From the Fingal Libraries autumn–winter 2026 brochure: Sensory Play Hour at Baldoyle Library, Saturday 14 November at 10:00. The brochure does not give an end time or an age. Sessions like this are usually for little ones. The brochure’s general note says library events are free.
events.age_hint_en: No age in the brochure; it suits little ones
events.booking_en: The brochure doesn’t say if you need to book

events.title_zh: 斯沃兹图书馆：家庭故事会
